verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an Order MCP server that lets agents fetch an order's current state, including line items, fulfillment events and post-purchase adjustments. It also documents webhook subscriptions for near-real-time event data and an Admin API with scoped access tokens, so status monitoring is well covered. The pack shows only read-side visibility, not an agent driving fulfillment or returns without a human. Missing for 10: documented write operations to create or advance fulfillments, explicit return/refund workflows via API, order-specific webhook topics, and hands-on or independent corroboration of end-to-end headless post-purchase handling.
